name: patient_is_exposed_to_pyridostigmine_now@@for_treatment_of_any_condition_other_than_myasthenia_gravis
meaning: Boolean indicating that the patient is currently exposed to pyridostigmine for the treatment of any condition other than myasthenia gravis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of any condition except myasthenia gravis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis, or for no treatment indication, or for an unknown indication.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the indication for pyridostigmine is for any condition other than myasthenia gravis.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_pyridostigmine_now@@for_treatment_of_myasthenia_gravis
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis, or is taking it for another indication, or for no treatment indication.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_pyridostigmine_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to (taking) pyridostigmine.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently taking or otherwise exposed to pyridostigmine, regardless of the indication.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not taking or exposed to pyridostigmine.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently taking or exposed to pyridostigmine.

name: patient_is_taking_pyridostigmine_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently taking pyridostigmine.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine.

name: patient_is_taking_pyridostigmine_now@@for_treatment_of_myasthenia_gravis
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine but not for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
